response.content:
## Companies Launched in Denmark in 2026

There is no single definitive registry listing every company launched in Denmark in 2026, but sector-level data from startup tracking platforms gives a clear picture of the scale and breadth of new company formation this year:

### Startup Formation by Sector (founded in 2026, as of late 2026)

| Sector | New startups founded in 2026 |
|---|---|
| **SaaS** | 137 |
| **Consumer** | 45 |
| **FinTech** | 18 |
| **HealthTech** | 9 |
| **Environment** | 8 |
| **Healthcare IT** | 6 |
| **Gaming** | 4 |
| **Education** | 4 |
| **Legal Tech** | 3 |
| **IT Operations** | 3 |
| **AgriTech** | 2 |

### Notable Launches and Events in 2026

- **InstallatørGruppen A/S** completed its Initial Public Offering (IPO) on Nasdaq Copenhagen in June 2026, marking a significant new public listing in Denmark.
- **Uber Direct** is launching in Denmark in 2026, bringing its white-label delivery service to the Danish market.
- **Danish Centre for AI Innovation (DCAI)**, which operates Denmark's AI supercomputer Gefion, received a DKK 500 million investment with Netcompany joining as a new co-owner alongside the Novo Nordisk Foundation and EIFO — supporting Denmark's 2026 government ambition to become an AI frontrunner.
- The **Kassø e-methanol facility** in Aabenraa, developed by European Energy in partnership with Mitsui & Co., commenced operations in 2026 — a major Power-to-X milestone.

### Recently Funded Danish Startups (2026 rounds)

Several Danish startups raised funding rounds in 2026, including:
- **Hi Rasmus** – Series C (September 2026)
- **Good Tape** – Seed (October 2026)
- **Aisel Health** – Seed (August 2026)
- **Proxi Biotech** – Seed (September 2026)
- **Kvantify** – Seed (March 2026)
- **KineDB** – Seed (October 2026)
- **Dropla Tech ApS** – Seed (July 2026)
- **Dawn Health** – Series C (February 2026)

Denmark's startup ecosystem remains highly active in 2026, with SaaS being the dominant sector for new company formation, followed by consumer-focused ventures and fintech.

# Strategic Account Manager, Uber Direct - Denmark

Location
:   Hovedstaden, Denmark / Denmark

Team
:   Operations

Subteam
:   Business Operations

Position Type
:   Full time

Posted on
:   Nov 10, 2026

a person with long hair wearing a white jacket and blue shirt

Meet the team

Raquel, Head of Rider, MEA

About the Role

Alongside Uber Eats, we are launching Uber Direct in Denmark. Uber Direct is our white-label delivery service that enables merchants to offer fast, same-day delivery from their own websites, apps, or stores — with no need for customers to use the Uber app. [...] You will own the initial GTM commercial strategy (pipeline creation and sales) for the market. As we launch our first merchants, you will then transition to also focus on scaling our merchants’ operations and driving long-term commercial health of our partnerships. You will be the vital link that translates high-level digital strategy into scalable, on-the-ground delivery operations.

Success here requires intrinsic drive to solve tough problems and the ability to influence and align stakeholders with competing priorities. You must stay steady under pressure, using data to navigate ambiguity and drive results for your partners. You will build deep expertise in the local delivery ecosystem and help define the standard for how the Danish market experiences on-demand last mile delivery. [...] This is the ideal role for someone with a strategic mindset coupled with next-level sales and account management skills and an operational curiosity. You will have the rare opportunity to launch a market from scratch, pilot new features, operating models, and commercial structures, which can be playbooked and scaled across Uber.

What You Bring to the Table
